name: Red Larch
summary: Waystop and quarrying village on the Long Road on a low ridge at the western edge of the Dessarin Valley; the Cairn Road leads east toward Bargewright Inn and a trail leads west toward Kheldell.

identity.ruler_office: Constable Harburk Tuthmarillar in 1491 DR; no confirmed 1492 DR ruler
identity.namesake: Stand of red larch trees cut down by the first settlers

layout: The Long Road runs through town; the Cairn Road heads east toward Bargewright Inn and a trail heads west toward Kheldell.
The Swinging Sword fronts the Long Road; the Allfaiths Shrine is on its west side, south of the inn.
Mhandyvver's Poultry is beside Luruth's Tannery on the Long Road, opposite Vallivoe's Sundries; which side of the road each is on is not stated.
A spring feeds a small pond used to water draft animals; its exact location is not established.
Nurnath's barn lies north of town beside the Long Road; a cart track heads east through orchard and pasture toward Old Angrath's hilltop smokehouse (circa 1372 DR).
Oneshield's four quarries lie in the hills east of town (circa 1366 DR). Lance Rock lies about 15 miles south-west, off the sketch.
uncertain_readings: Local streets, road bends, plotted buildings, pond side of road and distances inside the village are illustrative.
The wiki's interactive Map:Red Larch page was unavailable on 2026-10-06; no marker coordinates are known.
The working sketch places Mhandyvver's Poultry and Luruth's Tannery east of the road and Vallivoe's Sundries west, solely to show their opposite relationship.
